mandate: C429 — test the price-only SIGNENTROPY: order-1 Markov sign-transition dynamics (transition entropy H_trans = -Σ p_ij log p_ij, transition asymmetry asym = p_+- - p_-+, persistence p_stay = (p_++ + p_--)/2, switching p_switch = (p_+- + p_-+)/2) stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2592 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; sign=sign(log_return) (+1/-1/0, sign[0]=0). Over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing signs s_i[t-W..t] (W+1 signs): order-1 Markov 2x2 transition matrix on {+1,-1}; N_++ = count(s[k]=+1, s[k+1]=+1), N_+- = count(+1,-1), N_-+ = count(-1,+1), N_-- = count(-1,-1); p_++ = N_++/(N_+++N_+-), p_+- = N_+-/(N_+++N_+-), p_-+ = N_-+/(N_-++N_--), p_-- = N_--/(N_-++N_--); H_trans = -p_++*log(p_++) - p_+-*log(p_+-) - p_-+*log(p_-+) - p_--*log(p_--); asym = p_+- - p_-+; p_stay = (p_+++p_--)/2; p_switch = (p_+-+p_-+)/2. NaN if t<W or any NaN/non-finite in the W+1-bar trailing close span (global across assets), degenerate window (all same sign or no transitions), or not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 8 real+placebo (signentropy_trans_entropy_dev, signentropy_trans_asym_dev, signentropy_p_stay_dev, signentropy_p_switch_dev) + 4 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W+1-bar close window).

methodology.raw_features: perp_close real 5m kline close from C312 (strictly positive, gap-free); log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; sign=sign(log_return) (+1/-1/0, sign[0]=0).
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing signs s_i[t-W..t] (W+1 signs); order-1 Markov 2x2 transition matrix on {+1,-1}; N_++ = count(s[k]=+1, s[k+1]=+1), N_+- = count(+1,-1), N_-+ = count(-1,+1), N_-- = count(-1,-1); p_++ = N_++/(N_+++N_+-), p_+- = N_+-/(N_+++N_+-), p_-+ = N_-+/(N_-++N_--), p_-- = N_--/(N_-++N_--); H_trans = -p_++*log(p_++) - p_+-*log(p_+-) - p_-+*log(p_-+) - p_--*log(p_--); asym = p_+- - p_-+; p_stay = (p_+++p_--)/2; p_switch = (p_+-+p_-+)/2.
methodology.signals: signentropy_trans_entropy_dev/signentropy_trans_asym_dev/signentropy_p_stay_dev/signentropy_p_switch_dev plus phase-randomized-surrogate placebos over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2592 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.signentropy_vectorization_note: sign matrix S=(T,10) built once; per asset, sign series s[j]; per window ending at t, trailing W+1=257 signs s[t-W..t]; transitions s[k]->s[k+1] for k in [t-W, t-1]; mask out transitions from s[k]=0; count N_++, N_+-, N_-+, N_--; transition entropy/asymmetry/persistence/switching per window; validated against brute-force per-window loop with explicit transition counting, maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
